name: ShengShou Mr. M 5x5
reviews: Giá tốt để thử 5x5 có nam châm
description: The ShengShou Mr. M 5x5 is a budget friendly, factory magnetized 5x5 speed cube. This puzzle has a medium to light magnetic feel. It is naturally fast out of the box and, at this price point, is sure to impress beginners and advanced solvers alike.
